source: University of Bath banana ripeness estimation data; DOI 10.15125/BATH-01459; CC BY 4.0

preprocessing.merge: feature/label files joined one-to-one after verifying matching source index sequences
preprocessing.scaling: not applied; fit scalers only on training data inside model pipelines
preprocessing.spectral_floor: values around 5.88e-39 retained pending metadata/source clarification

limitations: VOC sensors are TGS2620, TGS2602 and SGP40, not MQ-135.
TPHiS contains BME280 and spectral features, not MQ-135 or LDR.
VOC and TPHiS row indices must not be used to merge the two subsets.
The sample-level random split may place related time-adjacent observations in train and test; results do not prove new-bunch generalization.
